Container.Name: excalidraw-live
Container.Overview: Live agent-editable Excalidraw canvas with persistent scenes, images and snapshots. Packages yctimlin/mcp_excalidraw (MIT), unchanged, plus a stdio MCP launcher. One shared scene; coordinate concurrent editors. No authentication. Default port binds to server loopback and requires an SSH tunnel for browser access. MCP connects through SSH and docker exec -i; port 3000 is browser/REST/WebSocket, not HTTP MCP. Runs as UID 99/GID 100 with a read-only root filesystem. See install instructions before changing exposure.

Config.Name: Canvas port (loopback)
Config.Description: Host binding port. forward this port with SSH. Container port is fixed at 3000.

Config.Name: Persistent appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated writable directory owned by UID 99/GID 100. Back up the complete directory while stopped. Never share between canvas instances.

Config.Name: Persistent data directory
Config.Description: Keep /data to enable durable scene, binary files and snapshots.
